claim: That Friday, seventy-one tornadoes came down
true_wording: From Friday evening into Saturday, the Weather Service confirmed seventy-one tornadoes.
verbatim_quote: During the evening of December 10th and 11th, 2021, a potent storm system brought widespread severe weather. SPC 11 Dec reports: 1217 UTC Elkton TN, 1336 UTC Coalmont TN (both Appendix C), 1741 UTC Falls of Rough KY, 2216 UTC Irwinton GA (Appendix C row 67 = Saturday 4:16 PM CST). Wikipedia: Bowling Green tornadoes formed 1:09 and 1:19 AM CST Sat; Saloma 2:20 AM. Not all 71 fell on Friday.
